propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL is a single scalar that cannot express per-tier mapping and is superseded by class-specific configuration (REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_ARTIFACT_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_PLANNER_MODEL)
REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be registered in _deprecations.REGISTRY via _scheduled() with a migration window (remove_in=_MAJOR at v1.0.0) rather than a permanent alias
The deprecation warning must be emitted at both env-read sites: config.py:469 (direct read) and model_classes.py (fan-out read), with per-call emission and no once-per-process dedup
When only REBAR_LLM_MODEL is set and no per-class configuration exists, it must resolve to all three classes with a single deprecation warning per load_class_slots() call
User-facing strings in --help output, MCP tool descriptions, and docstrings must present class configuration as the current interface and mark REBAR_LLM_MODEL as deprecated

Documentation must include complete example configurations for Anthropic-only, Bedrock-only, mixed-provider, and local+fallback patterns under docs/, plus an ADR recording the class model and deprecation rationale
